subject: Generate repo-pinned dashboard links in client instructions
description: Update Zonoid's installer/generated instructions so dashboard links include the current/client repo workspace query parameter instead of only the generic /graph URL. Ensure local AGENTS/CLAUDE guidance and install output point agents to the repo-pinned link for the target workspace.

summary: Updated dashboard links to be repo-pinned. bin/install.js now prints /graph?workspace=<encoded target workspace>. packages/cli/bin/zonoid.js now computes dashboardUrl(cwd), rewrites copied CLAUDE.md dashboard URLs to the client repo path, and prints pinned next-step URLs for all harnesses. Local AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md now point at the pinned zonoid workspace. Actionable skills/adapter docs and onboarding review output use repo-pinned or parameterized dashboard links. Added cli-init tests for URL encoding and CLAUDE.md rewrite behavior; tests and syntax checks pass.
